deviations_from_paper.explanation: Every evidence item is a character range into an emitted text file; verify.py re-slices it and recomputes the share that still matches.

envelope.condition: method text plus a run configuration

envelope.note: parameters listed as not_reported; never inferred, never rejected

envelope.condition: config in a format other than JSON
envelope.note: only JSON is parsed; other keys are reported as absent

failure_modes.mode: parameter in the text but not in the config
failure_modes.impact: not_reported with the quote; run continues
conflict flagged, status partial, both values quoted
checklist all unknown, status partial, no inference

note: This is a skill-authoring challenge: the targets are the demonstration benchmark and the audit, not a paper's reported numbers.
